chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.co.za item nutrition, every size McDonald's lists (20 Nov 2026). McDonald's South Africa publishes Calories; kilojoules are worked out. Allergens are McDonald's own list for each item. Items whose energy is more than a third away from their macros are left out. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Nando's
chains.src: Nando's South Africa online menu, Allergens & Nutritional Info (20 Nov 2026). Nando's lists each item per 100 g with its serving weight; a serve is worked out from the two. Items with no serving weight are left out. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Wimpy
chains.src: Wimpy South Africa classic menu nutrition and allergens (20 Nov 2026), each item as Wimpy lists it. Figures Wimpy shows under more than one item are left out. Nut means peanuts or tree nuts

chains.name: Debonairs Pizza
chains.src: Debonairs Pizza Nutritional & Allergen Guide (20 Nov 2026). Pizzas are the whole pizza, one row per size. Nuts means peanuts or tree nuts. Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Kauai
chains.src: Kauai menu nutrition and allergens (20 Nov 2026), per serving as ready to eat. Smoothies are listed at 350 ml and 500 ml

chains.name: Simply Asia
chains.src: Simply Asia allergen and nutrition schedule (Allergens-Menu-2024.pdf, dated August 2024), per dish as served. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. Allergens as marked in the schedule (it covers sesame). Changes to a dish ("Rice to ...", "NO VEG"), plain vegetable ingredients and the 6-piece combo platter are left out; sodium over 8,000 mg for one dish is a misprint and left blank. Left out 3 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros: Extra Calamari (with sauce) (97 kcal vs 23 from macros); Scoop of Ice Cream (127 kcal vs 226 from macros); Extra Seafood (with sauce) (97.2 kcal vs 53 from macros). (22 Nov 2026)
